# Retained proof documents

The `.tex` files are byte-pinned theorem sources. `finite_check.py` checks their hashes and phrases.

`INTEGRATED_PROOF.md`, `FINITE_BIT_ACCOUNTING.md` and `PARITY-CONTRACT.md` are retained verbatim from the
PR234 and source527 packages. Their arguments apply to this package unchanged. Their numerical instances,
such as R, W, stock, bills and digests, describe the earlier source471 and source527 helpers, not this package's p = 10 word.
The p = 10 values are recomputed by `verify.py` and stated in `../PROOF.md` and `../BANK-PROOF.md`.
